title: Routing Probes Can Improve Without New Information: An Exact-Null Audit of Uncertainty Beyond Model Outputs
abstract: arXiv:2609.38956v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Routing signals of modern vision transformers -- expert gates, attention-residual weights and halting scores -- often improve probes that predict whether the model is correct, and the improvement is commonly read as evidence that routing carries information about errors beyond the model's outputs. We test this inference directly: keeping real output-routing pairs, we redraw correctness labels from a frozen output-only generator fitted on disjoint data, so that routing is uninformative by construction. Under this exact label null, a width-matched MLP comparison still reports a routing gain in 51.3% of confidence-only evaluations (308/600), while a linear comparison reports none. Holding each training trajectory fixed on a six-model panel and selecting the checkpoint by validation log loss instead of validation accuracy removes the detections (50/120 to 0/120, and 83/120 to 0/120 in an independently implemented probe), identifying accuracy

translated_title: 路由探针无需新信息也能提升：对超出模型输出之不确定性的精确零假设审计
translated_abstract: 现代视觉Transformer的路由信号——专家门控、注意力-残差权重和停止分数——常常能改进用于预测模型是否正确的探针，而这种改进通常被解读为路由携带了超出模型输出的错误信息的证据。我们直接检验了这一推断：在保留真实的输出-路由配对的同时，我们从在互斥数据上拟合的冻结的仅输出生成器中重新抽取正确性标签，从而使路由在构造上不包含任何信息。在这种精确的标签零假设下，宽度匹配的MLP对比方法仍在51.3%的仅置信度评估中报告出路由增益（308/600），而线性对比方法则没有报告任何增益。在六个模型的面板上固定每条训练轨迹，并改用验证对数损失而非验证准确率来选择检查点，可以消除所有这些检出结果（从50/120降至0/120，在独立实现的探针中从83/120降至0/120），从而确认了准确率……
tldr: 该论文提出一种“精确零假设”审计方法，揭示视觉Transformer路由信号对错误预测探针的增益可能是统计假象——在路由被构造为完全无信息的零假设下，MLP探针仍会虚假地报告路由增益，而改用验证对数损失（而非验证准确率）来选择检查点可完全消除这类虚假检出。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an exact-null audit revealing that apparent gains of routing signals in error-prediction probes for vision transformers can be statistical artifacts—under a null where routing is uninformative by construction, MLP probes still spuriously report routing gains, and selecting checkpoints by validation log loss instead of validation accuracy eliminates these false detections entirely.
